title: "Research"

## Multi-breed genomic prediction in beef cattle

I built and validated a full genomic prediction pipeline for puberty and fertility traits (reproductive tract score, pelvic height/width, days open, heifer pregnancy) across five beef cattle breed populations — Angus, Red Angus, Hereford, a Bos indicus-influenced population, and a pooled MultiBreed population of over 9,000 animals genotyped on an 800K SNP panel. The pipeline spans univariate, bivariate, and multi-trait single-step GBLUP and GBLUP models via BLUPF90+/GIBBSF90+, with genetic parameter estimation (heritability, genetic correlations) via REML/AI-REML and prediction accuracy validated using the LR (Legarra & Reverter, 2018) temporal validation framework. Related work includes a Breed-As-Trait analysis estimating genetic correlations for the same traits measured across different breeds, and a population-stratification-adjusted (PCA-corrected) extension of the MultiBreed models.

## Cross-species, evidence-informed genomic prediction in legumes

Building on a systematic RNA-seq meta-analysis of common bean stress transcriptomes (19 public datasets, machine learning and network-based gene discovery), I evaluated whether SNP subsets prioritized by proximity to biologically evidenced stress-responsive genes improve genomic prediction accuracy relative to standard equal-weight GBLUP and random-marker controls. This framework has been applied to bacterial wilt and soybean cyst nematode resistance in common bean, and — via cross-species ortholog mapping — to abiotic stress tolerance (drought, salt) in cowpea.

## Disease resistance breeding and genetics

My earlier graduate and industry work focused on plant pathology and disease-resistance breeding directly: breeding spinach for resistance to the downy mildew pathogen *Peronospora effusa*, including genetic characterization of resistance loci and race-specific resistance across worldwide germplasm, and three years evaluating field corn, sweet corn, and soybean for pathogen resistance within Syngenta's Trait Assessment pipeline.
